QUOTE: Gate 2: deny (`ServerManager::execute`...) "This runs after approval and checks deny even for calls that were auto-approved or allow-listed."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says execution passes through two gates, approval and deny. The item says the deny list is the only blocker and that ServerManager consults `is_denied` and nothing else. The answer contradicts this by adding an approval gate that also blocks.
